SELECTED_INDEX: 7
CONFIDENCE: 0.64
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong aromatic system (ring ν(C=C) at 1600 cm⁻¹ and aromatic C–H stretches at ~3073 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003) plus clear ether signatures: two intense bands in the C–O stretch region (1091 and 1210 cm⁻¹) and an additional weaker band near 1036 cm⁻¹, consistent with two different C–O linkages (Ar–O–R and R–O–CH₂R′) expected for a di-ether. The pair of strong out-of-plane C–H bands at 802 and 834 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a disubstituted benzene ring. The strong bands at 636 and 656 cm⁻¹ indicate a C–Cl stretch (C–Cl region ~600–700 cm⁻¹; cf. GFQ-046). No carbonyl band (~1700 cm⁻¹) or O–H stretch (~3200–3600 cm⁻¹) is observed, disfavouring carbonyl- or hydroxyl-containing candidates. Altogether, these features best match the di-ether with a chloromethyl group, COc1ccccc1OCCl (candidate 7).
